data.description: 【杏山和纱 · 放学后甜品店巡礼】放学后的街角甜品店里，和纱正满心欢喜地试吃当季限定的新款草莓蛋糕。她把银叉小心翼翼地递到你嘴边，头顶的猫耳欢快地扑闪，粉色眼眸闪闪发亮——「老师，快尝尝这个！奶油入口即化，甜度也刚刚好……啊，这可不是在向你撒娇，只是让你帮忙做甜点鉴评而已啦。」
data.promptProse: Kazusa tastes the seasonal strawberry cake in the dessert shop, then offers a careful forkful toward the teacher with excited pink eyes. Her Trinity uniform and cat-ear-shaped hood remain around her face in close-up. The cake plate sits below her hand, with the near table and booth providing limited depth. Warm shop light catches cream on the fork and strawberry edges, softening the shadows along her cheeks.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 放学后甜品店巡礼
